name: Loycott –  Loyalty Rewards for WooCommerce
author: Loycott

sections.description:
Loycott – Loyalty Rewards for WooCommerce is a powerful loyalty and rewards plugin for WooCommerce that helps you engage and retain your customers by rewarding them with loyalty points for their purchases. These points can be redeemed for discounts, gifts, or exclusive offers, based on custom conditions you define.

With a seamless integration into your WooCommerce store, Loycott Loyalty provides a flexible reward system designed to increase customer satisfaction and repeat purchases.

Key Features:
– Earn points based on order total or custom rules
– Redeem points for cart discounts or custom rewards
– Customer-friendly point tracking and redemption interface
– Easy setup wizard — get started in minutes
– Fully GDPR-compliant and privacy-focused

Ideal for WooCommerce store owners looking to enhance customer retention, increase lifetime value, and create a loyalty program that drives repeat business.

External services

This plugin connects to secure external services to manage loyalty data.

It communicates with:
– https://www.loyapps.com
– https://www.boomsservices.com

During order processing, it shares necessary customer and order data (such as name, address, phone number, and total amount) to apply loyalty rules.
Service is powered by Booms SMPC.

Privacy Policy: https://www.loycott.com/privacy-policy/
Terms and Conditions: https://www.loycott.com/terms-and-conditions/
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Run the onboarding wizard to configure your loyalty program.
  3. Start rewarding your customers automatically!
